comments.body: @droid Please review this exact candidate for full discovery-schema preservation, deep-copy isolation, FastMCP supported API compatibility, unchanged invocation/result handling, and auth/policy regressions. The frozen normal-path comparison passed; merge remains gated by complete CI and substantive review.

**Droid finished @magnus919's task** —— [View job](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/actions/runs/38253970445)

---
The gateway change now preserves complete upstream input schemas while retaining the existing proxy invocation path. The experiment's control comparison checks only structured content, so it can miss changes to text content or the remote error flag.

Resolved finding-6a2005ca363e412e6251 in c540b6e without modifying the frozen worker or reacquiring measurements. verify.py.txt applies every frozen schema/count/control gate to retained output: original baseline returns nonzero, original candidate returns zero; seven deliberately corrupted records are rejected by verify-tests.py.txt. The registration now explicitly distinguishes measurement collection from the decision gate. The implementation, thresholds, corpus and primary outcomes are unchanged.

Addressed Droid’s control-comparison concern in 68ca36d using retained records only: both complete upstream and gateway CallToolResult objects are exactly unchanged for both controls, including text content and isError. The verifier now enforces full baseline/candidate control equality; nine corruptions (including text/error flags) fail, also under Python -O. Original worker, primary observations and implementation are unchanged; no repeated API measurement.

@droid Please review final head 68ca36d after the two concerns were resolved. The frozen collector is unchanged; a separate optimization-safe verifier now rejects schema/count/control failures and enforces complete raw control equality including text and isError. Both original controls are byte/value-identical across baseline and candidate. Nine deliberate corruptions are rejected. No primary measurement rerun or threshold change.

**Droid finished @magnus919's task** —— [View job](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/actions/runs/38255777164)

---
The gateway implementation preserves the complete upstream input schemas while retaining the existing invocation path. The verifier still does not enforce the frozen catalog-name and description guardrails, so gateway discovery metadata changes can pass its current checks.

Substantive runner fallback review of final candidate `68ca36d6ac8043b57da99f1c4d155171cea5159c`: positive, no actionable findings remain. Earlier automated/Droid concerns were addressed; no usable positive final-head Droid review has arrived yet. The standing runner fallback applies.

Reviewed registration/lifespan, invocation/result path, deep-copy isolation, schema/argument tests, and collector/verifier. FunctionTool construction uses the same generated callable as prior registration; only discovery parameters are replaced with a deep copy. Authentication, upstream policy/validation, pagination, result conversion and portal response paths remain unchanged. The authenticated replay preserves all 38 current input schemas, including all three primary specialist/planning contracts, and source mutation isolation/nested forwarding tests pass.

The frozen collector remains immutable. The separate explicit decision gate checks membership, counts, all schema equality, complete raw response controls and zero provider calls. The baseline fails, original candidate passes, and nine corruptions fail even under -O. Complete text/error-flag control equality is verified from retained records; no primary reacquisition, exclusion or threshold change. This resolves the two earlier review concerns.

All final-head CI passes, including both full Python suites and portal/Valkey/API/security gates. Local eleven-module transport isolation passes; remainder failures are retained and reproduce unchanged baseline (active-environment preflight/inventory), not counted as passing local full validation. No production, agent-task or host-UI uplift claim.

## Blockers
- [ACCEPTED / BLOCKING] **finding-6a2005ca363e412e6251** Worker reports schema mismatches without enforcing the guardrails at [docs/experiments/evidence/EXP-120/worker.py.txt:30](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/ea08a32dd04da0424362cc5e8e7bbb5c72772fc9/docs/experiments/evidence/EXP-120/worker.py.txt#L30). The worker computes \`primary\_passed\`, \`catalog\_equal\`, and control equality values, writes them to JSON, and prints counts, but contains no assertions or nonzero exit condition for failed comparisons. Consequence: A future run can complete successfully despite schema or control regressions, so this worker alone does not enforce the documented stop-on-failure guardrails. Rule: The experiment contract lists schema equality and unchanged control behavior as guardrails and says to stop on any primary or guard failure. Evidence: [ev-740a5521cd8da75d0d08ada8](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/ea08a32dd04da0424362cc5e8e7bbb5c72772fc9/docs/experiments/evidence/EXP-120/worker.py.txt#L1), [ev-9d9ad79f7360be590b9ce272](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/ea08a32dd04da0424362cc5e8e7bbb5c72772fc9/docs/experiments/EXP-120-gateway-input-contracts.md#L1).

## Suggested improvements
None recorded.

## Specific strengths
- **note-0e88aad295b98af37945** Tests cover schema fidelity, isolation, and forwarding: Added tests compare the complete nested schema, mutate the registered schema to check copy isolation, retain a helper-call compatibility case, and verify nested arguments are forwarded unchanged. These cases exercise both discovery representation and the proxy’s invocation responsibility, the two distinct behaviors the design separates. Evidence: [ev-5560d33693abec1d5b24f9c2](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/ea08a32dd04da0424362cc5e8e7bbb5c72772fc9/tests/test_mcp_gateway.py#L1).
- **note-12e3953e52a5f8dd5e8e** Preserves remote schema details independently of proxy signatures: The gateway passes a deep copy of the complete remote input schema to the standalone FastMCP tool registration path, rather than relying only on the generated Python signature. This retains JSON Schema constraints that Python signatures cannot represent and avoids sharing mutable schema data with the remote schema object. Evidence: [ev-2626f69cbb1a2c187dbd2dd6](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/ea08a32dd04da0424362cc5e8e7bbb5c72772fc9/slopsearx/mcp/gateway.py#L173).
- **note-52cc14636cf62e23e145** Tests schema preservation and argument forwarding: Changed test source checks complete nested schema preservation, isolation after mutation, compatibility of registration without an explicit schema, and forwarding nested arguments unchanged. These cases directly exercise the changed gateway behavior and its compatibility path. Evidence: [ev-443bfa75c7f313b7e170a05d](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/ea08a32dd04da0424362cc5e8e7bbb5c72772fc9/tests/test_mcp_gateway.py#L318), [ev-5560d33693abec1d5b24f9c2](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/ea08a32dd04da0424362cc5e8e7bbb5c72772fc9/tests/test_mcp_gateway.py#L1).
- **note-7e0fae3416a29c87b04f** Separates callable invocation from discovery-schema preservation: Proxy registration preserves the complete remote schema separately from the generated callable signature, and deep-copies the schema before assigning it to the registered tool. This keeps discovery fidelity from being constrained by Python signature expressiveness and avoids mutation of the source schema through shared nested values. Evidence: [ev-2626f69cbb1a2c187dbd2dd6](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/ea08a32dd04da0424362cc5e8e7bbb5c72772fc9/slopsearx/mcp/gateway.py#L173).
- **note-b9e0a5650c5480a7b0e4** Tests exercise schema fidelity and forwarding behavior: The added tests cover nested schema preservation, compatibility when the optional schema argument is omitted, and forwarding nested argument values. These cases document the registration contract and protect both existing helper usage and the proxy's data-forwarding behavior. Evidence: [ev-443bfa75c7f313b7e170a05d](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/ea08a32dd04da0424362cc5e8e7bbb5c72772fc9/tests/test_mcp_gateway.py#L318), [ev-5560d33693abec1d5b24f9c2](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/ea08a32dd04da0424362cc5e8e7bbb5c72772fc9/tests/test_mcp_gateway.py#L1).
- **note-ba7f777fa55f811738f4** Explicit boundary for schema preservation: The experiment proposal distinguishes discovery metadata preservation from invocation behavior, retaining existing argument handling and upstream validation; it also calls for deep-copying the remote schema. This makes the intended responsibility boundary clear and guards against proxy registration mutating the upstream schema source or implying new local validation behavior. Evidence: [ev-9d9ad79f7360be590b9ce272](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/ea08a32dd04da0424362cc5e8e7bbb5c72772fc9/docs/experiments/EXP-120-gateway-input-contracts.md#L1), [ev-f6569a411b67c3be1f7a8d6a](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/ea08a32dd04da0424362cc5e8e7bbb5c72772fc9/docs/experiments/EXP-120-gateway-input-contracts.md#L1).
- **note-e15c2cebc19ad3bdcca3** Discovery schema is kept distinct from callable argument inference: Registration deep-copies the remote input schema into the tool parameters while retaining the callable proxy for forwarding. This preserves schema constraints and metadata that Python signatures cannot represent, without sharing mutable nested schema data with the remote schema object. Evidence: [ev-2626f69cbb1a2c187dbd2dd6](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/ea08a32dd04da0424362cc5e8e7bbb5c72772fc9/slopsearx/mcp/gateway.py#L173).
